question: Can CFTC positioning, aggregate S&P 500 insider trading, or SEC filing manager tone provide one point-in-time, primary-literature-grounded and project-ready action for the fixed US30/US100 replacement before any portfolio outcome is opened?

screen_contract.failure_semantics: Source, causality and action ambiguity is a readiness/design state. It is not an economic hypothesis failure and cannot be promoted into one without opening complete valid economics under a frozen contract.

cftc_cot_position_revelation.prospective_program_and_height: Program 2 / meso external scheduled information release

official_source.available_project_period_files: Official annual Traders in Financial Futures files exist for 2022 through 2026 and contain Dow Jones, Nasdaq-100 and S&P 500 consolidated contracts.
official_source.official_timing: The report describes each Tuesday's open interest and is normally released Friday. Exact historical release dates outside the CFTC's retained recent schedule are not supplied as one complete point-in-time calendar.

primary_paper.title: Are Speculators Informed?
primary_paper.author: Krista Schwarz
primary_paper.paper_role: Tests whether the unexpected component of Tuesday speculative positions moves futures prices when the positions become public around the Friday 15:30 ET COT release.
primary_paper.unexpected_position_construction: A recursive augmented autoregression predicts the Tuesday legacy non-commercial position from its prior Tuesday position and the prior Friday-to-Friday futures return; the residual is the announcement surprise.
primary_paper.economic_horizon: Five-minute futures return around the COT announcement, with additional weekly and monthly return tests.
primary_paper.published_breadth: The announcement coefficient is significant for only four of eight contracts. E-mini Nasdaq is positive, while E-mini Dow and E-mini S&P announcement coefficients are not significant; explanatory power is small and longer-horizon results are mixed or adverse.

readiness_gaps: The project-period TFF categories are not the paper's legacy non-commercial classification. A legacy reconstruction would still require exact contract-continuous futures returns and release vintages before a paper-equivalent residual can be frozen.

The paper's key action is a five-minute futures announcement response. It does not identify a month-level regime, a fixed trade gate, or a transfer into the fixed candidate's existing intraday US30/US100 lifecycle decisions.

The primary evidence is not concordant across the two adjudicated books: Nasdaq is informative in the paper, while Dow is not. S&P/US500 remains read-only Cross context rather than a third book that can manufacture breadth.
Using Friday as a generic release date, a modern TFF category, CFD return, rolling percentile or raw net-position sign would create a new treatment not validated by the paper.

official_source.coverage: January 2006 through June 2026 at the screen date, updated quarterly.
official_source.source_semantics: As-filed Forms 3, 4 and 5 XML flattened by the SEC, including filing date, original submission date, form, issuer CIK/symbol, owner relationship and nonderivative/derivative transaction tables.

primary_paper.title: Aggregate insider trading in the S&P 500 and the predictability of international equity premia
primary_paper.formula: AIT_t = (sum purchases over the prior 12 months - sum sales over the prior 12 months) / (sum purchases + sum sales over the prior 12 months).
primary_paper.universe: S&P 500 membership at each month-end from Compustat; non-S&P 500 AIT is reported as noise.
primary_paper.paper_cleaning: 2iQ transaction processing; reporting-date timing; exclude trades outside the SOX two-business-day reporting window, employee stock options, automated preannounced 10b5-1 trades, and observations with missing volume or value.
primary_paper.published_horizon: Predicts the US equity premium at 1, 3, 6 and 12 months over 2004-2018 and is used as a continuous predictive-regression input rather than a fixed binary trade signal.

readiness_gaps: The SEC bulk source does not contain historical point-in-time S&P 500 membership. Replacing Compustat month-end membership with today's constituents or a survivorship-biased list would destroy the paper's only informative universe distinction.

The SEC source cannot reproduce the paper's proprietary 2iQ cleaning. In particular, a clean structured 10b5-1 affirmative field was mandated only after the project horizon began; earlier plan classification is buried in nonuniform footnotes.
The paper supplies a continuous forecast variable and mean-variance allocation exercise, not a natural AIT sign threshold or a frozen US30/US100 candidate gate.
Raw purchases-minus-sales, Form 4 counts, current-constituent subsets, value thresholds or a purchase-only signal would be unvalidated substitutes selected after seeing source availability.

primary_paper.title: Manager Sentiment and Stock Returns
primary_paper.firm_document_tone: (Loughran-McDonald positive-word count - negative-word count) / total word count for the full filing after images, tables, exhibits, HTML, symbols and non-text are removed.
primary_paper.financial_statement_component: Simple cross-sectional mean across nonfinancial, nonutility positive-asset 10-K and 10-Q filings in each filing month, then a four-month moving average weighted by monthly report count.
primary_paper.published_composite: SMS = 0.5 * standardized conference-call tone + 0.5 * standardized financial-statement tone; each component is standardized to full-sample mean zero and unit variance.
primary_paper.published_direction: Higher manager sentiment predicts lower future aggregate market returns; the action is contrarian over one month through one year.
primary_paper.update_evidence: The 2019 update extends only through December 2017. The financial-statement-only coefficient remains significant and negative while the updated conference-call component is insignificant.

author_index_capture.limitations: Static revised composite only; no financial-statement component, source filing manifest, vintage history, release timestamps or values after 2017.

sentiment_category_vintage_audit.meaning: Positive and negative category membership is available as a pre-project fixed 2020 lexicon. Future neutral master-dictionary additions can still affect N_Words, so NetFileSize was screened as an outcome-free length denominator.

source_only_reconstruction_audit.base_public_variant: Only exact 10-K and 10-Q forms; exclude SIC 4900-4999 utilities and SIC 6000-6999 financials; per-filing tone uses current positive-minus-negative counts divided by N_Words; monthly cross-sectional mean; four-month report-count-weighted moving average.

normalization_sensitivity.calendar_pattern: For signal years 2023, 2024 and 2025, the trailing-12 rule is exactly high in January and July-December and low in February-June in every year. The apparent binary action is therefore perfectly identified by month of year over the three complete years.
normalization_sensitivity.meaning: The paper's full-sample standardization does not define a causal post-2017 zero. In the project period, reasonable strictly-prior normalizations produce materially different or degenerate actions before any portfolio result is read. Selecting a window now would select the hypothesis itself.

readiness_gaps: The author series ends in 2017, is a revised composite and has no point-in-time vintages. It cannot supply the 2022-2026 field directly.

The public SEC/Notre Dame surface can construct a financial-statement-only tone proxy, but it cannot reproduce the Compustat positive-asset universe or the proprietary conference-call component. The moderate 0.39 correlation confirms it is not the published composite.

Full-sample standardization is look-ahead. Strictly prior expanding normalization makes all 42 candidate months low-tone, while rolling windows introduce a largely deterministic calendar regime and materially disagree with one another.

The paper predicts monthly to annual S&P 500 excess returns and implements continuous mean-variance allocation. It does not identify a zero threshold, a short-horizon lifecycle gate, or concordant separate actions for the fixed US30 and US100 books.
Opening outcomes under a chosen 12-, 60-, five-year seasonal or other normalization would test an invented normalization/calendar treatment, not a source-ready replication of manager sentiment.

combined_readiness_decision.reason: Each clue has a real information mechanism, but the exact information surprise, investable universe, causal normalization or fixed two-book action is missing. Starting portfolio aggregation would force Codex to invent the decisive treatment from source convenience. The correct state is design/readiness correction without an economic verdict.

future_readiness_conditions: COT: exact legacy non-commercial series, continuous futures-return carrier and actual historical release availability sufficient to reproduce the paper's unexpected-position residual, plus an independently justified US30/US100 action beyond the five-minute futures response.

Insider trading: point-in-time historical S&P 500 membership and a reproducible predeclared cleaning rule that handles late filings, options and 10b5-1 plans across the full horizon, plus a fixed action not selected from project outcomes.

Manager sentiment: an author or primary-source current financial-statement series with vintages, or an independently supported causal normalization and monthly-to-project action that is fixed without choosing a rolling window from project outcomes.
Any future source must state its primary Program and height, complete data support, direction, action, lag, costs and economic falsification gates before opening candidate lifecycle outcomes.
forbidden_automatic_successors: COT category, contract, release window, lag, percentile, net-position sign or Friday-calendar substitution
insider purchase-only, count, dollar threshold, executive subset, current-constituent or rolling-window rescue
manager-tone 12/60-month, five/ten-year seasonal, expanding, percentile, sign, month, form, sector, component or denominator search
retrospective selection of the normalization that best aligns with fixed-candidate profit, drawdown, direction, book, component or month
treating US500 as a third adjudicated book
Proxy, MT5 or Lab economics before one exact source-to-action contract becomes ready
another GPT consultation because this combined readiness boundary is not a closed research unit
